issues.description: The milestone asks for a working install. The cited operator statement says it is finished, and no demonstration is in the shared record.
issues.requester_argument: Requester Northwind contests that the install was shown to work.
issues.operator_argument: The operator says the installation is finished.
uncertainties: A signature does not prove the install works.

prior_comparisons.requester_emphasis: The usable install is one equal declared factor. A signature does not show that it works.
prior_comparisons.operator_emphasis: The operator statement says the work is finished. That statement is a claim, not an observed demonstration.
prior_comparisons.unresolved_tradeoff: No agreed scalar settlement rule. This reading grants no award.

prior_comparisons.requester_emphasis: Declared effort is one equal factor. Unshown hours do not replace a working install.
prior_comparisons.operator_emphasis: The operator side does not show hours. Hours would not by themselves prove the install works.
prior_comparisons.unresolved_tradeoff: No agreed scalar settlement rule. This reading grants no award.

prior_comparisons.requester_emphasis: Reliance covers costs either party incurred because of the contract. None are itemized here.
prior_comparisons.operator_emphasis: No reserved-cost record is cited for the operator. Reliance stays an open label, not a sum.
prior_comparisons.unresolved_tradeoff: No agreed scalar settlement rule. This reading grants no award.

prior_comparisons.requester_emphasis: Responsibility asks who could have shown the install working. The record does not assign that control.

prior_comparisons.unresolved_tradeoff: No agreed scalar settlement rule. This reading grants no award.

prior_comparisons.requester_emphasis: A practical correction would be a demonstration of the install. No further unpaid scope is created here.

prior_comparisons.unresolved_tradeoff: No agreed scalar settlement rule. This reading grants no award.

prior_move.result_requester_emphasis: More weight on the usable install makes the missing demonstration the main open question. Hours spent answer less of this disagreement.
prior_move.effort_requester_emphasis: Less weight on effort means unshown hours do less to answer the disagreement. The missing demonstration remains the open point.
prior_move.tradeoff: The requester declaration puts more weight on result and less on effort. Signed profiles are unchanged. No settlement formula.
